# Project Model end-to-end fixture

This fixture is a small, local qualification dataset for the canonical Project Model.
`expected-project-model.json` is the expected-results manifest: it links two fictional
people's face observations, speech, and masks to their entity identities; records one
A-roll and one B-roll use; then records a trim that shortens the A-roll from 48 to 36
frames and a 24 fps render frame map.

The media are synthetic and generated by `generate_media.py` with FFmpeg and
espeak-ng. The SVG portraits and speech text are original fixture material; there
are no third-party media assets or external licenses. The generated files are
committed so qualification does not depend on local speech synthesis or network
access. Run `python3 -m library.tools.project_model validate-fixture` to check the
manifest against the Rust-generated Project Model JSON Schema and verify the media
files and the fixture's cross-entity expectations.
